test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as the one followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

OSO−SWS

IMI−MQM
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac48fa0a0eb3c8e48ade5e1401ef78361f465c3ad0e5d54dd34fac64b0eb2050.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, +4, +4

OSO−SWS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c59019ada1c2ad92946c53b53b51770f549574c6935892a4e5b28f2974c72b9.png] 

IMI−MQM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c9eca010a9559e7cc6c6bdc1b3bd24249da3ee2384925c6c453ced326972623.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. QUQ–UYU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d59b46e28f88446e26a95bda7b2aa35a34c2f56406809c0069f633374bfde5d.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, +4, +4.

2. QTO–TXT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f70d35157dcf65f1faab0f38b4e6ee166c380768c43f38e9c2c2d51d5f7b63fd.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +4, +4, +4.

3. QUQ–TYT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7e77ce40af9edf53112322df31ac290d96d9ff9ba7fe25ba4df00c233562612.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +4, +4, +4.

4. QTO–UYU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ee41ac8f2d0c5d4997524cf116dcd5a6642269f86eb5d5701464c121318666.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +4, +4, +4.

Thus, QUQ−UYU follows the same pattern as the one followed by the two pairs given.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
